title: Clean up the dissector handle code.
description:
Instead of using a void pointer to the dissector function, use a union
of function pointers, for the different types.

Fix a comment to reflect current reality, rather than what was the case
the *last* time we had more than one function signature for dissectors.

Use a switch statement on the dissector type, rather than an if chain.

commits_data.message:
Clean up the dissector handle code.

Instead of using a void pointer to the dissector function, use a union
of function pointers, for the different types.

Fix a comment to reflect current reality, rather than what was the case
the *last* time we had more than one function signature for dissectors.

Use a switch statement on the dissector type, rather than an if chain.
